summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (do not implement — for founder review)  **What I'd check first:** Reproduce the actual symptom before touching anything. I did a read-only audit of the whole chain (`WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist` → DB), and contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, the ownership-scoping from ARCA-19 looks correct: watchlist routes require a valid session, every query filters by `watchlists.user_id`, the client always fetches from the API (`credentials: "include"`, no localStorage/anonymous fallback), and the DB schema has a non-nullable `user_id` FK.
